svg.text: Forte-1 over four days, as Braket reports it and as IonQ reports it
Braket: tasks waiting in the Normal queue. A count, read every minute.
IonQ: average_queue_time, in hours, read as milliseconds. Updated every 15 minutes. Between 51 and 65 hours all week.
Both on one scale. Each minute ranked against the rest of its own series, 0 the emptiest that series showed, 100 the busiest.
If the two measured the same queue, the lines here would rise and fall together. They do not. Rank correlation 0.05.
